text:
Predicates:
Composer(x) ::: x is a composer.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
MusicPiece(y) ::: y is a music piece.
Premieres(z, y) ::: z premiered y.
Orchestra(z) ::: z is an orchestra.
Leads(x, z) ::: x leads z.
Conducts(z) ::: z is a conductor.
Question: 
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Beethoven is a composer.
Premises:
SymphonyNo9 :: is a music piece.
Composer(x) ∧ Wrote(x, SymphonyNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
ViennaMusicSociety :: is an orchestra.
Premieres(ViennaMusicSociety, SymphonyNo9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Leads(Beethoven, ViennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(z) → ∃x (Leads(x, z) ∧ Conducts(x)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
Composer(Beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
